name: Griddled aubergines with sesame dressing
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 2 large aubergines (800 g total) providing 4 modest side or starter portions when griddled and dressed; original source implies 4 servings.
Total time is active prep and cooking only (no passive time); griddling in batches may extend slightly but base estimate is 20 min.
Greek yogurt confirms dairy and non-vegan; tahini confirms sesame; herbs and lemon juice introduce no allergens with certainty.
No wheat, barley, rye or oats used; recipe is gluten-free by ingredients.
No tree nuts, peanuts, eggs, fish or shellfish appear in listed ingredients.
instructions:
step 1
Brush each aubergine slice with some oil, then season. Heat a griddle pan or barbecue. When hot, griddle the aubergine slices for 2-3 mins on each side until golden brown and tender.

step 2
Mix the yogurt with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice and herbs, then season. Top the aubergines with the dressing and scatter over extra herb leaves.

ingredients.name: Aubergine
ingredients.assumptions: 2 large aubergines ≈800g total raw weight; edible flesh only (skin is included in weight but not subtracted as it is eaten).

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp olive oil; standard 14 g per tbsp, used for brushing and griddling.

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt
ingredients.assumptions: 250 g Greek yogurt as given; typical full-fat strained variety.

ingredients.name: Tahini Paste
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tbsp tahini paste; ≈15 g per tbsp, standard sesame paste.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 1 clove garlic crushed ≈5 g; typical peeled weight.

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of 1 lemon ≈30 g (≈2 tbsp); typical yield from a medium lemon, only the juice is used.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Handful fresh coriander ≈15 g; typical loose bunch handful for mixing and scattering.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Handful fresh parsley ≈15 g; typical loose bunch handful for mixing and scattering.

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.assumptions: Handful fresh mint ≈15 g; typical loose bunch handful for mixing and scattering.
